name: fitness-buddy
description: An AI-powered conversational health and fitness coach using IBM Granite through IBM watsonx.ai.

problem_statement.title: Fitness Buddy
problem_statement.challenge: Provide accessible, personalized fitness guidance, nutrition suggestions, and motivation to help individuals maintain a healthy lifestyle.
objectives: Recommend home workouts and routines based on user input.
Provide motivational tips and daily fitness inspiration.
Suggest simple and nutritious meal ideas.
